fusions.name: Cut on the Shoal
fusions.desc: A kick that deals 13 damage, knocks the target 2.5 tiles back and leaves it [Bleeding] and 6% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Breaking Reef
fusions.desc: Coral bursts up around you, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Razor Crust
fusions.desc: For 9 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Your movement speed rises 15% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Over the Shallows

riders.text: you gallop over it faster than over ground
and the spray gives your wind back
and nothing wading can keep up

fusions.desc: You gallop on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you move 15% faster on it, from silver your stamina recovers 25% faster on it, and from gold your dodge chance rises 10% on it.
